text: ＊は　＊の　＊で　まひして　わざが　でにくくなった！

structure.jp: わざが　でにくくなった！
structure.en: its moves became hard to get out!

patterns.name: 〜で (cause)
patterns.explanation: で here shows what caused the thing to happen, like 'because of' or 'by'. ＊の　＊で = 'because of ＊'s ＊'.

patterns.name: 〜にくい
patterns.explanation: にくい stuck onto a verb means that thing is hard to do or does not happen easily. でにくい = 'hard to come out'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: Changing い to く and adding なる says something became that way. でにくくなった = 'became hard to come out'.
